_comment: T-11 weapon edits: the values that cross the engine boundary with a class and a take that can fail. Nothing here is a damage number - damage travels as the 24:2 ratio through T-14's health row.

edits.behaviour: BmAK fires the 60 mm cannon every FiringInterval seconds; JC3's `fire_rate` is the same quantity in the same unit (seconds between shots)
edits.take: Q-3 #3: six consecutive shots at a wall, timed from the recording; pass = 2.0 s +-0.15 between rounds
edits.why: the only unit that converts 1:1 between the engines on this weapon

edits.behaviour: the shell leaves the muzzle at 400 m/s (40000 UE units/s at 1 UU = 1 cm, the unit `bat_assemble.py` uses for the whole car)
edits.take: Q-3 #3: time a shell to a wall 40 m away; pass = 0.10 s +-0.02 (400 m/s), and the same shell reaches a target at 100 m inside 0.30 s
edits.why: cm/s -> m/s is exact; whether JC3's `velocity` is m/s is inferred from the 25-id band 360..900, so the class is `derived` and the take can fail it

edits.behaviour: the Vulcan fires 1/0.138 = 7.25 rounds a second (BmAK FiringInterval)
edits.take: Q-3 #3: hold the trigger 2 s into a wall; pass = 14 +-1 impacts and no overheat (the BmAK heat rate is 0)
edits.why: same unit; the tank's 0.1 s is 10 rounds/s and would out-fire the BmAK gun
